label: FP
reason: Both alerts are false positives. Alert 1 (XSS): User input flows through getHeader->param->decode->bar->doSomething->sql->concatenation, BUT the switch statement in doSomething() uses hardcoded guess="ABC" making switchTarget='B', which sets bar="bob" (constant). The resolved sink value is "bob", not user input. Alert 2 (SQL Injection): Same data flow ends at sql variable, but bar resolves to constant "bob" due to switch case 'B'. The resolved sink value is a literal constant, not attacker-controlled.
